spanish: Y harás masaj a abertura de la tienda, azul y púrpura y carmesí y lino fino torcido, obra de bordador.

findings.issue: Common noun left untranslated as masaj; the token licenses a Spanish noun, not a Hebraized dump.
The definite construct (opening of the tent) is rendered without the Spanish article on abertura.

notes: Lemma 8336 b licenses lino fino; the following passive participle licenses torcido.
